claim: Patchline ships a red-team evaluation of the agent against prompt-injection in migration descriptions. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the prompt-injection claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make agent-prompt-injection-redteam-gate`.
